data.name: Escape the Urban Underground.
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the Shadows - Escape Room

Escape the Urban Underground delivers a terrifying, highly immersive VR escape room experience that will push your mind to the limit. Deep beneath the bustling city lies a forgotten subway station, sealed off from the world for decades. A gruesome murder has just taken place on these decaying platforms, but you quickly realize you are not alone.

The Single-Session Challenge

This is a pure, unadulterated escape challenge that tests your nerves. Designed to be completed in a single, intense run with a maximum time of 60 minutes. Users who have already enjoyed the full experience have taken between 120 and 240 minutes to complete it, over multiple attempts, this game features absolutely no save points and no checkpoints. Once you enter the station, the clock starts ticking. You must connect the clues, solve the murder, and find your way out in one breathless attempt.

Tactile VR Puzzles

Interact closely with an eerie environment built exclusively for Virtual Reality. You will need to carefully investigate the scene, restore power to rusted transit terminals, hack cryptic geometric security panels, and navigate through debris-filled, claustrophobic train cars. Every puzzle requires hands-on logic, sharp observation, and quick thinking.

Face the Unknown

Flickering lights, distorted audio, and a looming sense of dread make every shadow a threat. Can you keep your cool under pressure, or will you become another permanent ghost of the urban underground?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR: Compatible only with Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest 3 and Meta Quest Pro. Fully compatible with Oculus/Meta Quest Link. Steam Link compatibility may be limited.
  • Additional Notes: Video game compatible only with Virtual Reality.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR: Compatible only with Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest 3 and Meta Quest Pro. Fully compatible with Oculus/Meta Quest Link. Steam Link compatibility may be limited.
  • Additional Notes: Video game compatible only with Virtual Reality.
